capital.evidence_quote: Apia is the capital and primate commercial seaport of the Independent State of Samoa

currency.evidence_quote: The Samoan Tālā (WST, WS$) is the official currency; trades around 2.75 WST to 1 USD

timezone.evidence_quote: Samoa operates on West Samoa Time UTC+13 year-round, on the west of the International Date Line

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply voltage across Upolu and Savai'i is 230V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Alternating current power grid operates at 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Australian standard Type I three-pin plugs with angled pins are universal in Samoa

sources.title: Samoa Police, Prisons and Corrections Services

police.evidence_quote: Dial 22222 or 995 for emergency police assistance throughout Samoa

sources.title: Tupua Tamasese Meaole (TTM) Hospital Ambulance Dispatch

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 996 for emergency medical dispatch and hospital ambulance services

sources.title: Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA)

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 994 for emergency fire and rescue services

general.evidence_quote: 999 serves as the unified emergency operations hotline

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Police headquarters in Apia provides tourist assistance at +685 22222

advisory_headline.tr: Samoa son derece güvenli ve geleneklerine bağlı bir Polinezya ada ülkesidir; standart seyahat önlemleri yeterlidir.
advisory_headline.en: Samoa is exceptionally safe, tranquil, and deeply hospitable; exercise normal travel precautions.
advisory_headline.de: Samoa ist ein überaus sicheres und gastfreundliches Reiseland; normale Vorsichtsmaßnahmen genügen.
advisory_headline.ru: Самоа исключительно безопасно и спокойно; действуют обычные правила.
advisory_headline.es: Samoa es un destino sumamente seguro, pacífico y hospitalario; aplican precauciones normales.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Samoa reach approximately 28.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Apia measure 48.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Vodafone Samoa and Digicel provide 4G tourist SIMs at Faleolo International Airport (APW). Inter-island vehicle/passenger ferries connect Upolu (Mulifanua Wharf) with Savai'i (Salelologa Wharf) multiple times daily.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Tourist prepaid SIMs require passport presentation under national telecommunications law

religion.value: Christianity (approx. 98%, predominantly Congregational Christian/EFKS, Roman Catholic, and Methodist)
religion.evidence_quote: Samoa is constitutionally founded on God; Christian faith is central to the Fa'a Samoa (Samoan Way)

festivals.value: Teuila Festival in September (national cultural extravaganza), White Sunday (Lotu Tamaiti in October), Fire Knife (Siva Afi) World Championships
festivals.evidence_quote: Teuila Festival celebrates traditional dance, canoe racing, and the heart-stopping fire knife dance

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Respect Fa'a Samoa (the 3,000-year-old Samoan Way): during the evening prayer curfew (Sa - usually 18:00 to 19:00 marked by bells/conch shells), avoid walking or driving through traditional villages. Sunday is strictly kept as a day of worship and family rest.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: During evening Sa prayer time, visitors must remain quiet and indoors until the second bell sounds

tipping.value: Tipping is not expected or customary in Samoan culture; Fa'a Samoa emphasizes unconditional hospitality. A warm thank you ('Fa'afetai tele lava') is the customary gesture.
tipping.evidence_quote: Tipping is not part of Samoan custom and is not required
